not_covered: The EU AI Act entered into force in phases between 2024 and 2027 because the phased entry was deliberate, designed so that obligations would land as institutional capacity and technology mature [Source: ev-1].
This schedule also serves to double as a compliance roadmap for providers worldwide [Source: ev-1].
The "unacceptable risk" practices are banned outright starting on February 2, 2025 [Source: ev-1].

While the text mentions other dates (such as August 2, 2026) associated with high-risk system obligations in its general description of phases [Source: ev-1], it does not provide further specifics about those requirements within the scope of the provided still-open items or supporting details beyond that single prohibition date.

The different deadlines require the following specific obligations:
*   **Prohibited practices:** "Unacceptable risk" practices are banned outright from 2025-02-02 [Source: ev-1].
The Act was published in the EU Official Journal on 2024-07-12 and entered into force on 2024/08/01 [Source: ev-1].
